title: Ruby Redux
description: A resourcepack merging Healing Pretty Good's features with Ruby Exchange, Mining Master, and Heartstone
body:
A resourcepack designed to be used with Inqusitive that merges [Healing Pretty Good](https://modrinth.com/mod/healing-pretty-good)'s beautiful animated ruby features with that of a select few other mods, such as:

[Heartstone](https://modrinth.com/mod/heartstone)

[Mining Master](https://modrinth.com/mod/mining-master)

[The Ruby Exchange](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/team-neon-ruby-exchange)
